availability.lfp_14500_line: solar-light replacement channel, ~$0.4-1/cell wholesale; AA-form mix-up hazard; dominated
availability.lfp_18650_line: AliExpress brand stores, wholesale $0.6-1.2/cell, JP-observed ~JPY700/cell (secondary, 2026-08); no JP retail; dominated

lfp_32700.capacity_fraud: claims of 6000/6500/7000 mAh for the same can; datasheet class tops at 6500 mAh (Misenpower IFR32700); >6500 = marketing; mitigation: brand store only + discharge-test on arrival
lfp_32700.jp_domestic_distributor_bare_cells: none found (Akizuki: no; Monotaro: finished LFP products only; Yodobashi: none)
lfp_32700.supply_3y: plausible via solar-DIY demand; channel exposed to UN38.3/carrier tightening

nimh_eneloop_aa.amazon_jp_price: UNVERIFIED (line is sold there; live price not separately observed)

basis.nimh_runtime_note: refreshed from 1.86 d: current eneloop BK-3MCD is 2000 mAh min (was 1900)

lfp.charge_time_6500mah_pair: ≈3.5-4 h at 2 A x2 (VX4 slots 1+4); ≈2.5-3 h single at 3 A

charger_fit.liitokala_lii_s8_s12: 3.65 V LFP output but size lists cap at 26650 — out on fit
charger_fit.nitecore_ums4: DOES NOT FIT — official compatibility ends at 26700
charger_fit.xtar_vx2_pro: FITS on paper — Ø10-32 mm, 34-80 mm, 32700 listed; 2 slots; same diameter caveat
charger_fit.xtar_vx4: FITS with caveat — 32700 in slots 1 & 4 only; stated limit 32 mm thick / 83 mm long vs cell Ø32.2±0.3 x 70.5 mm (Misenpower): diameter 0.2 mm over nominal limit; test-fit required

lfp.rotation_minimum: 4 cells for the x2 week configuration (2 in use + 2 spare); 2 cells only for x1 configuration
lfp.storage: spares at ~40-60% SOC (~3.2-3.3 V); VX2 Pro has Store mode; full-charge storage accelerates calendar fade; self-discharge <3%/month class
lfp.wrong_charger_risk_mitigation: XTAR VX4 V2 charging-mode memory; one dedicated charger labelled LFP-only
lfp.wrong_profile: 4.2 V Li-ion profile overcharges by ~0.55 V: electrolyte oxidation, gassing, fast fade, spends the LFP safety margin (XTAR product text warning; low-risk-power.md §4)

nimh.profile_risk: none — NiMH-only device, AA/AAA slots only, no modes

charging.nimh_storage: spare set fully charged, ~85-90% retained after 1 year (Panasonic LSD claims) — grab-and-go
charging.one_charger_for_both: YES — XTAR VX4/VX2 Pro (NiMH 0.5 A fixed on VX4, ~4-4.5 h for 4 AA; LFP mode charger-wide; no simultaneous 3.7 V Li-ion + LFP). Caveat: shared charger reintroduces per-session mode switching; one chemistry per charger is the safer household rule

three_year_cost.electricity_note: 5.1 kWh at cells, ~6.8 kWh at wall, JPY31/kWh — negligible for both
three_year_cost.reconciliation: earlier ~JPY3 (NiMH) / ~JPY4-5 (LFP) per day were 5-year amortisations; LFP also rises because no JPY2,600 charger fits 32700 with an LFP mode — real floor is XTAR VX4 at JPY5,519

verdict.easier_to_live_with: NiMH — domestic commodity supply, zero-discipline charger, shelf-ready spares; its only cost is a ~2-day swap rhythm
